summary: Implemented EXT-04 backend behavior end-to-end for optional edge transform expressions. Added GraphEdge.transform model support and propagation across definition import/export/snapshot/API graph duplication paths. Added transform validation in definition lifecycle validation pipelines (create, update, import, activation). Added runtime transform handling in transition flow for task and service-task edge traversal with strict ordering after output merge and before next-node activation, including empty-transform no-op semantics. Added EE-10 error routing from completeTask for transform evaluation failures and non-object transform results with dedicated error types and payload mapping. Added unit tests for transform validation and runtime behavior including missing-variable failure and empty-transform pass-through.
